thread:
marco-eng: @samantha-oncall @taylor-security PagerDuty just alerted for auth-rate pattern against sse-proxy -> sudden 401 spike + a few log objects in s3 containing "session_token" substrings. Not sure if full tokens leaked but looks like snippets. Paging triage.
pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 created and assigned to samantha-oncall. Priority: P1. Runbook: auth/credential-exposure.
samantha-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Pulling metrics and logs now. Initial numbers: ~6k 401s between 03:12-03:20 UTC, spike sourced from ~12 IPs + ASN 64500. No customer-facing 5xx yet.
opsbot: Quick log query run:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-edge-logs/proxy/2026-03-17/03/*.log - | grep -E "session_token|auth_header"
# found ~18 lines with partial token fragments (masked) in staging and prod-edge indexer
```
opsbot: Note: objects flagged: s3://redwood-edge-logs/proxy/2026-03-17/03/edge-03.log.gz (redacted sample attached)
taylor-security: Thanks. Are these complete tokens or truncated fragments? Any PII visible? If fragments only, rotate service keys and invalidate session caches ASAP. Also need timeline of exposures.
elaine-sre: Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) add temporary WAF rule to block the 12 IPs + ASN 64500; 2) enable 429 for suspicious SSE requests to fail-fast; 3) flip feature flag to disable SSE for public endpoints while we rotate keys. I can apply WAF in 2-3m.
samantha-oncall: Mitigation plan (execute now):
- WAF block IP ranges -> elaine-sre applying
- Create new KMS key alias `alias/sse-proxy-rot-20260317` and stage deploy using key in env
- Deploy new build that picks up KMS alias
- Flush KV caches / invalidate tokens via `curl -X POST http://kv-control/flush?service=sse-proxy`
ETA: 20-30m for rotation + deploy. I'll coordinate.
taylor-security: Also prepare rotation for the service account creds used by indexer (svcacct-indexer) — their logs show snippet patterns. If any full tokens were saved to S3, we need to consider targeted customer notification. Legal, can you advise on exposure threshold for notification?
legal: Please share sample redacted lines + list of affected s3 objects and any proof of exfil. If tokens are partial and not reconstructable, likely internal handling only; if complete creds/tokens found we may need to notify. Send via DM or secure channel.
custsuccess-andy: I'll stand by. Preparing list of customers with SSE enabled and high qps. If we need to communicate, we should aim for a short factual note + recommended rotation steps for customers. Keep me posted on scope.
pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 status updated -> Mitigating. Assigned: samantha-oncall. Current phase: active mitigation.
samantha-oncall: Mitigations applied: WAF rule in place blocking 3 /24s + ASN; new KMS key created and aliased `alias/sse-proxy-rot-20260317`; deploy completed at 03:46 UTC (env picks up new key); cache flush sent to redis cluster and KV pods; rotating svcacct-indexer credentials now (secrets rollout in progress). Monitoring logs for regeneration attempts and auth failures.
samantha-oncall: Initial assessment: token fragments present but no evidence of full token replay. Customer impact: none reported so far. Still treating as potential exposure — full rotation executed for critical service accounts. Handing off to night oncall @elaine-sre for post-rotation verification and 4h watch. Will update runbook entries with timestamps and commands run. If new findings surface, escalate back to security/legal.
elaine-sre: Taking handoff. I'll verify edge error rates, watch auth success rates, and confirm no residual 401 flood. Leaving a reminder to rotate any long-lived keys linked to indexer tomorrow morning and run `audit:reconcile-keys` job.
marco-eng: Thanks team. Please put a short post-mortem stub in #postmortems/incidents once stabilized; keep comms tight. :thumbsup:
